sentences.textHi: JavaScript se sirf websites banti hain?
Aap JavaScript se powerful backend servers bhi bana sakte ho!
sentences.textEn: You can build powerful backend servers with JavaScript too!

sentences.textHi: Ye ek JavaScript runtime environment hai, jo aapko browser ke bahar JavaScript run karne deta hai.
sentences.textEn: It's a JavaScript runtime environment that lets you run JavaScript outside the browser!

sentences.textHi: Ab Node.js ki help se aap APIs bana sakte ho, database se connect kar sakte ho, aur client ki requests handle kar sakte ho.
sentences.textEn: With Node.js, you can build APIs, connect to databases, and handle client requests!

sentences.textHi: Sirf kuch lines mein hum apna pehla Node.js HTTP server bana sakte hain.
sentences.textEn: In just a few lines, we can build our first Node.js HTTP server.

sentences.textHi: Toh ab JavaScript sirf frontend tak limited nahi hai!
sentences.textEn: So JavaScript is no longer limited to frontend!

sentences.textHi: Ye backend development ka bhi powerful tool hai.
sentences.textEn: It's a powerful tool for backend development too!

sentences.textHi: Follow karo aur chalo saath mein complete 100-day challenge karte hain!
sentences.textEn: Follow along and let's complete the 100-day challenge together!
